notes.title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Editions Detailed
notes.content:
The land of Azuma may be full of mysteries and legends now, but soon you’ll get to fly through the skies and explore this never-before-seen region all on your own. 

Spoiler warning: This trailer goes hard. 

[previewyoutube=8yy8WP3jXTQ;full]https://youtu.be/8yy8WP3jXTQ[/previewyoutube]

Along with this new trailer, we’ve also got details about what’s included in the digital editions of Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma available at launch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172005/ed8993ffd25d510230ecef74ec8811c5996d1aca.jpg
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Standard Edition ($59.99) 
 Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma base game 
 Subaru’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit (Lest), Kaguya’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit (Frey) 
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Deluxe Edition ($69.98) 
 Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma base game 
 Subaru’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit (Lest), Kaguya’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit (Frey) 
 “Seasons of Love Bundle” DLC: 
 Pilika’s Bonding Stories  
 Cuilang’s Bonding Stories 
 “Marvelous Swimsuit Bundle” cosmetic DLC: Subaru’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Kaguya’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Iroha’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Hina’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Murasame’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Ulalaka’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Mauro’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Kurama’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Kai’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Fubuki’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Matsuri’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Ikaruga’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Clarice’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Kanata’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Pilika’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Cuilang’s Marvelous Swimsuit  “Festive Attire and Dark Woolby Bundle” cosmetic DLC: Subaru’s Festive Attire, Kaguya’s Festive Attire, Dark Woolby 
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Super Digital Deluxe Edition ($79.98) 
 Includes the contents of the Digital Deluxe Edition, plus: 
 Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma digital soundtrack 
 Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma digital art book 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172005/381cae20038e49d3936e47655dcc1cebe6bb93db.jpg
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma “Digital Deluxe DLC” Set ($9.99) 
 “Seasons of Love Bundle”: 
 Pilika’s Bonding Stories  
 Cuilang’s Bonding Stories 
 “Marvelous Swimsuit Bundle” cosmetic DLC: Subaru’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Kaguya’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Iroha’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Hina’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Murasame’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Ulalaka’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Mauro’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Kurama’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Kai’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Fubuki’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Matsuri’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Ikaruga’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Clarice’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Kanata’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Pilika’s Marvelous Swimsuit, Cuilang’s Marvelous Swimsuit  “Festive Attire and Dark Woolby Bundle” cosmetic DLC: Subaru’s Festive Attire, Kaguya’s Festive Attire, Dark Woolby 
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma “Super Digital Deluxe DLC” Set ($19.99)  Includes the contents of the “Digital Deluxe DLC” Set, plus: 
 Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma digital soundtrack 
 Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma digital art book 

Wishlist now and get ready to experience a bold, new adventure in this beloved series, when Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma releases on June 5!
